text: REST API that uses JSON and authenticates requests with OAuth access tokens
quote: The SavvyCal API adheres to REST conventions. Our API communicates in JSON format and uses OAuth access tokens to authenticate requests.

text: API authentication through the OAuth 2.0 authorization code flow or personal access tokens
quote: OAuth 2.0 authorization code flow ... Personal access token authentication

text: API endpoints to list events, create events on a link, and cancel events
quote: List events GET /v1/events ... Cancel event POST /v1/events/{event_id}/cancel ... Create event POST /v1/links/{link_id}/events

text: API endpoints to update and duplicate scheduling links
quote: Update a scheduling link PATCH /v1/links/{link_id} ... Duplicate a scheduling link POST /v1/links/{link_id}/duplicate

text: API endpoint to get the available time slots for a link
quote: Get available time slots GET /v1/links/{link_id}/slots

text: MCP connection lets Claude, ChatGPT, Cursor and similar clients check the calendar, find open times, book meetings and manage links
quote: Connect Claude, ChatGPT, Cursor, VS Code, or another MCP client to check your calendar, find open times, book meetings, and manage your links from a chat.

text: Webhooks send HTTP POST notifications when changes happen in an account
quote: Webhooks allow you to listen for changes in a SavvyCal account and get notified via HTTP POST requests.

text: event.created webhook fires when someone books through a scheduling link
quote: event.created Emitted when someone schedules a new event via one of your scheduling links

text: Webhook payloads are signed with a SHA-256 HMAC sent in the x-savvycal-signature header
quote: SavvyCal signs the request body with a SHA-256 HMAC signature. The signature is included in the x-savvycal-signature header.

text: Failed webhooks are retried with exponential backoff up to 20 times, and a request log shows each attempt
quote: we will retry with exponential backoff, up to 20 attempts in all. To see each attempt with its request payload and your response, use the webhook's request log.

text: Custom metadata such as a user ID can be passed through a booking and returned in webhooks and the API
quote: To pass your own data, like a user ID, through a booking and get it back in webhooks and the API, see Storing custom metadata on events.

text: A workflow Send a webhook action runs your code at a set time before or after a meeting
quote: To run your code at a set time before or after a meeting, use a workflow's Send a webhook action.

text: JavaScript library embeds scheduling links inline, as a floating widget, or triggered from a hyperlink
quote: Display scheduling links inline, via a floating widget, or triggered based clicking a hyperlink.

text: Zapier app triggers no-code automations, such as syncing with a CRM or creating project to-dos
quote: Trigger no-code automations with Zapier ... Sync with your CRM, send yourself reminders, create project management to-do’s…the sky’s the limit.

text: Combined availability for you and any number of teammates, so recipients book the whole group
quote: Show combined availability for you and any number of teammates that allow recipients to book a time with your selected group.

text: Round robin distributes meetings across a pool of team members
quote: Distribute meetings across a pool of organizers. Perfect for sales and customer support.

text: Round robin can optimize for availability (next free person) or for evenness (next person in line)
quote: Optimize for availability gives each booking to the next person in line who's free. Optimize for evenness gives each booking to the next person in line, and shows only their times.

text: Each round robin host can have a priority, their own hours, location, and separate meeting limits on the link
quote: Each host in the rotation can have a priority, their own hours for the link, and their own meeting location, and meeting limits on the link count separately for each host.

text: A person can be excluded from the round robin so they are invited to every meeting
quote: Add the person and set them to Exclude from round robin, which invites them to every meeting.

text: Calendars of people outside your team can be included when showing availability
quote: Include calendars from people outside your team when showing availability.

text: Booked meetings can be reassigned to someone else, with everyone notified
quote: Reassign booked meetings, and let everyone know

text: Group mode lets several people book the same slot for webinars, cohorts, or office hours
quote: Let several people book the same slot for onboarding cohorts, webinars, or office hours.

text: Stripe payments are collected at booking, and the meeting is only confirmed once payment goes through
quote: Clients pay as they book, and the meeting only lands on your calendar once the payment goes through.

text: Sales tax, VAT, and GST are calculated and collected through Stripe Tax
quote: Calculate and collect sales tax, VAT, and GST with the click of a button (powered by Stripe Tax).

text: Clients can enter Stripe promotion or coupon codes at checkout
quote: Coupon codes. Let clients enter promotion codes you've set up in Stripe at checkout.

text: Paid offerings and prices can be created and adjusted inside SavvyCal
quote: You don’t even have to leave SavvyCal to create new offerings or adjust your prices. Do it all natively within SavvyCal.

text: Any payment method available in the connected Stripe account is accepted
quote: Connect your Stripe account to collect payments on your scheduling links. Collect sales tax if needed & accept any payment method available in your Stripe account.

text: Meeting limits cap how many meetings are booked per day, week, and month
quote: Limit how many meetings are allowed on a per-day, week, and month basis.

text: Calendar events act as time blocks, so a link only offers times inside matching events
quote: Put a "Demos" event on your calendar, and your demo link only offers times inside it.

text: Encourages booking near existing meetings to prevent calendar fragmentation
quote: Encourage people to schedule meetings near other meetings, to prevent calendar fragmentation.

text: Ranked availability windows steer recipients toward your preferred times
quote: Present ranked availability windows to encourage recipients to pick the optimal time (while still remaining flexible).

text: Free meeting polls let people vote on the times that work best for them
quote: Invite people to vote on times that work best for them. Available for free, no annoying ads.

text: Poll voters pick times and give their name and email without signing up
quote: Voters pick their times, then add their name and email. No sign-up, no password.

text: Scheduling the winning poll time adds it to your calendar, invites chosen voters, and closes the poll
quote: Hit Schedule on the winner, and SavvyCal puts the meeting on your calendar, invites the voters you choose, and closes the poll.

text: Workflows send customized meeting lifecycle messages and automate manual tasks
quote: It’s never been easier to send customized meeting lifecycle messages and automate manual tasks with SavvyCal workflows.

text: Workflows can be attached to multiple links and auto-attached to every new link
quote: Turn on "Automatically attach to new links," and every link you create from then on picks it up.

text: Multi-action workflows group several automation steps together
quote: Keep your automations neatly organized with powerful multi-action workflows.

text: Reminder timing and content are customizable, written from scratch or from templates, to cut no-shows
quote: Customize the timing and content of your reminders to increase attendance. Compose from scratch or pick one of our handy templates.

text: Pending workflow steps move when a meeting is rescheduled and are cancelled when it is cancelled
quote: Reschedule, and the steps still to come move to the new time. Cancel, and they're called off.

text: Messages can include the guest name, meeting time in their time zone, a reschedule link, and booking answers
quote: Drop in the guest's first name, the meeting time in their own time zone, a reschedule link, or their answers to your booking questions.

text: Unique Zoom rooms are created automatically for new events
quote: Automatically create unique Zoom rooms for new events.

text: Google Meet links are added to Google Calendar events
quote: Add Meet links to your Google Calendar events.

text: Whereby meeting rooms are attached to calendar invites
quote: Attach Whereby meeting rooms to calendar invites.

text: Bookers can overlay their own Google, Microsoft, or Fastmail calendar on your open times
quote: People booking with you can overlay their own Google, Microsoft, or Fastmail calendar on your open times, and pick a time that works without switching tabs.

text: Generates a text snippet of proposed times that recipients can book in two clicks
quote: Generate a snippet of text to propose times in just seconds. Recipients can pick a time to meet in just two clicks.

text: When proposing times, teammates can be added to help pick slots when they are likely free
quote: Pick any number of available time slots from your calendar. Optionally, add your teammates ahead of time to help you pick times when they are likely free.

text: Booking page shows a week view so recipients see every option at once
quote: We've replaced the "click-a-day, then click-a-time" routine with a high-fidelity week view, so recipients see every option at once.

text: Unlimited Google, Microsoft, iCloud, and Fastmail calendars are all checked for conflicts
quote: Unlimited calendarsGoogle, Microsoft, iCloud, and Fastmail, all checked for conflicts

text: Links can be customized with your own colors, banner image, and avatar
quote: Adjust the colors, banner image, and avatar that appear on your links to match your unique style.

text: Team logo, banner, and colors are set once, and Premium can hide the SavvyCal badge
quote: Set the team's logo, banner, and colors once. On Premium, host links on your own domain and hide the SavvyCal badge.

text: Booking pages can be hosted on your own custom domain
quote: Booking pages on your own domainbooking.yourcompany.com/you instead of savvycal.com/you

text: Confirmation and reminder emails are sent from your own email address
quote: Emails sent from your own addressConfirmations and reminders come from you, not us

text: Access can be delegated to an assistant who uses their own login
quote: Delegate access to an assistantThey use their own login, so you never share a password

text: Chrome extension gives quick access to your scheduling links
quote: Very easy to make multiple calendar links and access them via the Chrome Extension!
